# Agent Journal — scikit-learn #14629 fix (campaign)

## Findings
- TASK.md (read at step 1): fix IndexError in `cross_val_predict(..., method='predict_proba')`
  with MultiOutputClassifier (upstream scikit-learn issue #14629). Rules: minimal correct fix
  in SOURCE (not tests), leave changes uncommitted, do not touch tests.
- Root cause: `sklearn/model_selection/_validation.py` `_fit_and_predict` (lines ~856-866)
  does `estimator.classes_[i_label]` when the method returns a list. MultiOutputClassifier
  returns a list from predict_proba and (in this 0.22-dev checkout) has NO `classes_`
  attribute of its own -> AttributeError/IndexError.
- Upstream solution (verified against installed sklearn 1.9.1 in the venv):
  `MultiOutputClassifier.fit` sets `self.classes_ = [est.classes_ for est in self.estimators_]`
  after fitting. This checkout's MultiOutputClassifier has no fit override (inherits
  MultiOutputEstimator.fit), so I added one in `sklearn/multioutput.py` mirroring upstream.
- EDIT APPLIED (step 30, uncommitted): sklearn/multioutput.py — added
  `MultiOutputClassifier.fit(X, y, sample_weight=None)` that calls `super().fit(...)` then
  sets `self.classes_ = [estimator.classes_ for estimator in self.estimators_]` and returns self.
  git status: only sklearn/multioutput.py modified (+22 lines). Repo root = campaign dir.

## Verification environment (why it is hard here)
- Repo is scikit-learn 0.22-dev (mid-2019, git 4aded39b56). Venv python3.12 has sklearn
  1.9.1 installed in site-packages; importing repo source from repo root fails: no compiled
  extensions, and numpy 2.5.4 in venv has no numpy.distutils -> `setup.py build_ext` impossible.
- System python3.12 (C:/Python312/python.exe3.12) has numpy 1.26.4 + scipy 1.11.4 + Cython 3.0.8 + gcc.
- Verification strategy: copied repo to C:/Windows/Temp/skl_verify_run1 (tar, no .git), shimmed
  `sklearn/__check_build/_check_build.py` (real one is just `def check_build(): return`),
  copied venv's joblib + cloudpickle (pure python) into the copy, then compiled missing
  .pyx extensions one by one with cython3+g++ (murmurhash, _logistic_sigmoid,
  sparsefuncs_fast, _csr_polynomial_expansion, expected_mutual_info_fast, pairwise_fast,
  _cython_blas, _random, _hashing, _svmlight_format, seq_dataset(.tp expanded via
  Cython.Tempita), arrayfuncs, sag_fast(.tp), libsvm, libsvm_sparse).
- /tmp-copy-only compat patches (NOT in repo): np.int/np.float/np.bool -> int/float/bool
  (removed in numpy 1.24; sed over non-test .py), libsvm compiled via libsvm_template.cpp
  (dense+sparse symbols) with -fpermissive for the pyx TU.
- Remaining CYTHON-FAIL/CC-FAIL modules (not needed for this repro path): neighbors
  kd_tree/quad_tree/ball_tree/dist_metrics, tree/_tree, tree/_splitter, svm/liblinear,
  utils/fast_dict, ensemble/_hist_gradient_boosting/splitting.

## Decisions
- Fix stays minimal & upstream-shaped: set classes_ in fit, nothing else.
- Repo working tree must contain ONLY the multioutput.py change; all build shims live in /tmp.

## Questions
- none open
